title: "Launch executable file" dialog is modal and blocks plasmashell
line: The "What do you wish to do with this file?" dialog for an executable file on the desktop no longer freezes the panels and desktop until it's answered.
explanation: KIO's open-or-execute dialog (Open with / Launch / Cancel) always called setModal(true), which makes a dialog application modal. In plasmashell no QWidget parent exists, so the dialog blocked every plasmashell window: Kickoff, the clock and the rest of the panel ignored input until the dialog was answered. The change makes it modal only to its parent window when there is one (Dolphin still gets a window-modal dialog) and non-modal when there is no parent.

commits.message:
widgets: don't make the open-or-execute dialog application modal

The dialog was always made modal, and without a parent widget that blocks
every window of the application, so in plasmashell the whole desktop and
panels froze until it was answered. Make it modal only to its parent window.

BUG: 400255

From 39ce5a772716bdc087cdffab72c657b12976058a Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>

Subject: [PATCH] widgets: don't make the open-or-execute dialog application
 modal

The dialog was always made modal, and without a parent widget that blocks
every window of the application, so in plasmashell the whole desktop and
panels froze until it was answered. Make it modal only to its parent window.

BUG: 400255

 src/widgets/widgetsopenorexecutefilehandler.cpp | 2 +-
 1 file changed, 1 insertion(+), 1 deletion(-)

diff --git a/src/widgets/widgetsopenorexecutefilehandler.cpp b/src/widgets/widgetsopenorexecutefilehandler.cpp
index 816c84e2f..96d436566 100644
--- a/src/widgets/widgetsopenorexecutefilehandler.cpp
+++ b/src/widgets/widgetsopenorexecutefilehandler.cpp
@@ -72,7 +72,7 @@ void KIO::WidgetsOpenOrExecuteFileHandler::promptUserOpenOrExecute(KJob *job, co
     }
     ExecutableFileOpenDialog *dialog = new ExecutableFileOpenDialog(url, mime, promptMode(mime), parentWidget);
     dialog->setAttribute(Qt::WA_DeleteOnClose);
-    dialog->setModal(true);
+    dialog->setWindowModality(parentWidget ? Qt::WindowModal : Qt::NonModal);
 
     connect(dialog, &QDialog::finished, this, [this](const int result) {
         if (result == ExecutableFileOpenDialog::Rejected) {

review.text: Fixes the exact root cause in KIO's `WidgetsOpenOrExecuteFileHandler`: `ExecutableFileOpenDialog` already runs asynchronously via `show()` with `WA_DeleteOnClose` and a `this`-scoped signal connection, so replacing `setModal(true)` with `setWindowModality(parentWidget ? Qt::WindowModal : Qt::NonModal)` cleanly stops blocking `plasmashell` while preserving window-modality in QWidget apps like Dolphin. Before/after screenshots, videos, and Dolphin regression checks solidly prove the fix.

Fixes the scenario in the current title (and Nate's c5): KIO's open-or-execute dialog used setModal(true), which with no parent widget is application-modal and froze every plasmashell window. It now stays window-modal when there is a parent and becomes non-modal without one. This matches what KIO already did for the untrusted .desktop warning (f0ae0384) and Nate's c3 direction. It is a one-line change in the right repo; the screenshots and videos clearly show Kickoff and the calendar working with the dialog open, and Dolphin is verified to still get a window-modal dialog. Trade-off worth mentioning in the MR: a parentless dialog can now be opened twice by double-clicking again. A follow-up could honour KJobWindows::window(job) as transient parent, as the KIO 6.32 DeleteOrTrashJob change does, but that isn't needed to close this bug.
